name: DC custom spell: the prestige level 1 aura (800010) raises stats and gives them back on removal
description: Spell 800010 is a DC custom aura scripted in DC/Progression/Prestige/dc_prestige_spells.cpp (prestige level x Prestige.StatBonusPercent percent of every stat). Needs Prestige.StatBonusPercent >= 1 and an actor without prestige auras.

steps.label: No prestige aura before the test
Stamina rises by the configured percent
Removal gives back exactly what was added
